snippet.title: This Is Our Air Force
snippet.description:
Shopping carts, toy cars and a two-seat sofa take to the skies. Real gameplay cuts from workshop repairs to island flights, mounted-gun fire, a mid-air collision and a night fuel stop.

Will It Launch? is a co-op physics sandbox for PC on Steam. Build aircraft from scrap and find out how they fly.
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5205090/Will_It_Launch/

Music:
'Born Of The Sky' by Scott Buckley - released under CC-BY 4.0. www.scottbuckley.com.au
Source: https://www.scottbuckley.com.au/library/born-of-the-sky/
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
If edited: excerpted, level-adjusted and synchronized to gameplay.

#WillItLaunch #CoopGaming #IndieGame
